title: Zephyrine and the Static
author: N. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Yara Delacroix, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
